LeanApplyConfig.description: Settings for the lean_apply transactional edit.

onVerifyFailure.description:
What to do when post-edit verification fails:
- "rollback": restore the original file bytes (default).
- "keep": leave the edit in place and report it as unverified.

exposeRawBackendTools.description: Reserved. Raw lean-host-mcp tools are never registered by this package; this flag is kept for a future human-debug surface.

project.description: Optional absolute path to the Lake project root. Forwarded to backend operations that accept a project override. When omitted, the server's own --lake-root resolution is used.

url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of a running lean-host-mcp server. Start one with: lean-host-mcp serve --bind 127.0.0.1:8765
